colors.description: Semantic color roles for each theme; customize them through this layer.

typographyAndSpacing.description: Spacing and geometry scales by density. Configure fluid typography in typography.fluid.scales. Preserve the browser root size.

typographyRoles.description: Shared roles for reading text, controls, helper text, titles, and code. Fluid sizes resolve by density and width, with limits in rem.

defaultDensity.description: Initial scale; allowed IDs are compact/default/wide. The preference reader must follow changes to the initial value.

fontFamilies.description: The viewer uses the bundled Geist families under the SIL Open Font License.

radius.description: Shape roles shared across components, variants, and documentation.

layoutAndMotion.description: Motion shares durations, curves, and springs. Verify each composition’s layout and transitions per component.

roles.description: Selector option list; contains its options.
Inner row and highlight in a menu.
Inner tab, concentric with its container.
Small indicators, such as a checkbox mark.
Pills; circular shapes retain their own geometry.

constraints: Role-based shapes are shared across implementations and the viewer.
Inner radii derive from the container; do not duplicate values.
Circles, pills, open group corners, and decorative geometry retain their function.
Motion resolves the same CSS variables to pixels before interpolating.

roles.description: Input text, menu options, and table labels. Actions share this size with the Action style.
Paragraphs and reading content in an interface.
Help text, metadata, notes, and data labels.

components.description: Shared RAMS roles and additional component details.

constraints: Brand Color, Primary, Accent, and Selection are independent roles, even when they share primitives.
Brand derivatives are explicit decisions; changing Brand Color does not recalculate them.
After customization, verify color pairs, hover, focus, both themes, and real components.
The preset’s contrast results are not inherited automatically when its foundations change.
